title: Chicken Katsu Curry at Home in 4 Easy Steps
caption:
Chicken Katsu Curry at Home in 4 Easy Steps

Crisp chicken katsu with a thick Japanese curry sauce. Serves 2.

You need: 2 chicken breasts, flour, 1 egg, 60 g panko, oil, 1 onion, 1 carrot, Japanese curry roux for 2, rice.

Method: Flatten the chicken, coat in flour, egg, then panko. Shallow-fry 4 min a side until golden and cooked through (75°C). Soften the onion and carrot, add water as on the roux pack, simmer 10 min, stir in the roux. Slice and serve with rice and the sauce.

title: Chocolate Pancake Stack with Strawberries & Banana in 4 Steps
caption:
Chocolate Pancake Stack with Strawberries & Banana in 4 Steps

Fluffy pancakes with warm chocolate sauce, strawberries and banana. Serves 2.

You need: 200 g self-raising flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs, 200 ml milk, butter, 100 g dark chocolate, 150 ml cream, strawberries, 1 banana.

Method: Cook ladlefuls on a medium heat until bubbles show, flip for 1 min. Heat the cream, take it off the heat and stir in the chopped chocolate. Stack, pour on the sauce, add the fruit.

Steps 1-3 in the video are AI video clips; step 4 is a real photo of the dish that inspired this home version.

title: Caramelised Banana French Toast with Pecans in 4 Steps
caption:
Caramelised Banana French Toast with Pecans in 4 Steps

Thick French toast with caramelised banana and pecans. Serves 2.

You need: 4 thick slices of brioche, 2 eggs, 100 ml milk, ½ tsp cinnamon, butter, 2 bananas, a handful of pecans, 3 tbsp brown sugar, icing sugar.

Method: Soak the bread 20 seconds a side and fry in butter 2-3 min a side. In another pan melt 30 g butter with the sugar, add the sliced banana and pecans for 2 min. Pile on the banana, pecans and icing sugar.

Steps 1-3 in the video are AI video clips; step 4 is a real photo of the dish that inspired this home version.

title: How to Pour Heart Latte Art at Home in 4 Steps
caption:
How to Pour Heart Latte Art at Home in 4 Steps

Heart latte art at home.

You need: a fresh double espresso, cocoa powder, 150 ml cold whole milk, a steam wand and a small milk jug.

Method: Dust the crema with cocoa. Steam until the jug is hot to touch (about 60°C), then swirl until glossy. Pour from high to mix, then bring the jug close and pour into the middle until a white circle forms. Lift and draw a line through it.

Steps 1-3 in the video are AI video clips; step 4 is a real photo of the coffee that inspired this home version.

title: Avocado Toast with Roasted Tomatoes, Quinoa & Feta in 4 Steps
caption:
Avocado Toast with Roasted Tomatoes, Quinoa & Feta in 4 Steps

Avocado toast with roasted cherry tomatoes, quinoa and feta. Serves 2.

You need: 250 g red and yellow cherry tomatoes, olive oil, 2 thick slices of sourdough, 2 ripe avocados, lemon, 3 tbsp cooked quinoa, 50 g feta, rocket, salt and pepper.

Method: Roast the tomatoes with oil and salt at 200°C (fan 180) for 15 min. Toast the bread, mash the avocado with lemon and salt, then build it up. Top with the tomatoes, feta and rocket.

Steps 1-3 in the video are AI video clips; step 4 is a real photo of the dish that inspired this home version.

title: Kinako & Black Sesame Mochi Snow Ice (Bingsu Style) in 4 Steps
caption:
Kinako & Black Sesame Mochi Snow Ice (Bingsu Style) in 4 Steps

Milk snow ice with kinako and black sesame mochi. Serves 2.

You need: 400 ml milk, 4 tbsp condensed milk, 100 g glutinous rice flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 160 ml water, cornflour, 3 tbsp kinako (roasted soy flour), 3 tbsp ground black sesame.

Method: Freeze the milk mix flat 4+ hours, then scrape into flakes. Microwave the flour, sugar and water 1 min, stir, then 30 seconds at a time until translucent. Pile the snow ice and mochi into a bowl.

title: Eggs Florentine with Hollandaise at Home in 4 Steps
caption:
Eggs Florentine with Hollandaise at Home in 4 Steps

Poached eggs on spinach and a toasted muffin with hollandaise. Serves 2.

You need: 4 eggs + 2 yolks, 200 g spinach, 100 g butter, 1 tsp lemon juice, 2 English muffins, chives.

Method: Wilt the spinach in butter and squeeze out the water. Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3 min. Whisk the yolks and lemon over simmering water until thick, then slowly whisk in the melted butter. Build on a toasted muffin; add chives.

Steps 1-3 in the video are AI video clips; step 4 is a real photo of the dish that inspired this home version.

title: Matcha Pancakes with Blueberry Compote in 4 Steps
caption:
Matcha Pancakes with Blueberry Compote in 4 Steps

Green matcha pancakes with blueberry compote and cream. Serves 2.

You need: 150 g self-raising flour, 2 tsp matcha powder, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 egg, 180 ml milk, 150 g blueberries, 1 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon for the compote, whipped cream or thick yogurt, mint, icing sugar.

Method: Sift the matcha with the flour. Cook on a low heat 2 min a side. Simmer the blueberries 5 min. Stack with compote, cream, mint and icing sugar.

Steps 1-3 in the video are AI video clips; step 4 is a real photo of the dish that inspired this home version.

title: Loaded Mexican-Style Bowl with Quesadilla & Guacamole in 4 Steps
caption:
Loaded Mexican-Style Bowl with Quesadilla & Guacamole in 4 Steps

A loaded bowl with a chicken quesadilla, pico de gallo, guacamole and pickled onion. Serves 2.

You need: 1 red onion, 3 limes, 2 tomatoes, coriander, 2 avocados, 2 tortillas, 2 cooked chicken breasts (shredded, with 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp smoked paprika), 80 g grated cheese, sour cream, salt.

Method: Pickle the onion in lime juice and salt for 20 min. Toast the quesadillas 2-3 min a side. Pile it into a bowl with sour cream and lime.

title: Smoked Salmon & Scrambled Eggs with Hollandaise in 4 Steps
caption:
Smoked Salmon & Scrambled Eggs with Hollandaise in 4 Steps

Smoked salmon and soft scrambled eggs with hollandaise. Serves 2.

You need: 4 eggs + 2 yolks, 100 g butter, 1 tsp lemon juice, 2 handfuls of rocket, 150 g smoked salmon, chives, salt.

Method: Whisk the yolks and lemon in a bowl over simmering water until thick, then slowly whisk in the melted butter. Cook the beaten eggs on a low heat, stirring, until just set. Add the eggs, hollandaise and chives.

title: Glazed Chicken Ciabatta with Pineapple Salsa & Wedges in 4 Steps
caption:
Glazed Chicken Ciabatta with Pineapple Salsa & Wedges in 4 Steps

Sticky chicken ciabatta, pineapple salsa and sweet potato wedges. Serves 2.

You need: 2 sweet potatoes, oil, 2 chicken breasts, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ pineapple, ½ red pepper, ½ red onion, 1 chilli, 2 ciabattas, sriracha mayo, rocket.

Method: Roast the wedges at 200°C (fan 180) 25-30 min. Fry the sliced chicken 6-8 min until cooked through (75°C), add the honey and soy, cook until sticky. Fill with spicy mayo, rocket, chicken and salsa.

title: Potato & Veggie Frittata: Easy Brunch in 4 Steps
caption:
Potato & Veggie Frittata: Easy Brunch in 4 Steps

A thick potato and vegetable frittata. Serves 4.

You need: 2 medium potatoes, 1 red pepper, ½ green pepper, 3 spring onions, olive oil, 8 eggs, 50 ml milk, chives, salt and pepper.

Method: Boil the diced potato 8 min. Soften the peppers and spring onion in an ovenproof pan 5 min, add the potato and the beaten eggs and milk. Cook 3 min on the hob, then bake at 180°C (fan 160) 12-15 min until set. Cool a little, slice and add chives.

Steps 1-3 in the video are AI images; step 4 is a real photo of the dish that inspired this home version.

title: Banana Caramel Pancakes with Toasted Almonds in 4 Steps
caption:
Banana Caramel Pancakes with Toasted Almonds in 4 Steps

Fluffy pancakes with banana, caramel and toasted almonds. Serves 2.

You need: 200 g self-raising flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs, 200 ml milk, 30 g flaked almonds, 50 g butter, 50 g brown sugar, 100 ml cream, 2 bananas.

Method: Toast the almonds in a dry pan 2-3 min. Melt the butter and sugar, bubble 2 min, stir in the cream. Cook the pancakes until bubbles show, then flip. Top with banana, caramel and the almonds.

title: Easy Chicken Curry over Rice in 4 Steps
caption:
Easy Chicken Curry over Rice in 4 Steps

An easy, thick chicken curry over rice. Serves 2.

You need: 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, a thumb of ginger, oil, 2 tbsp curry powder, 400 g tin chopped tomatoes, 4 chicken thighs (diced), 100 ml water or coconut milk, salt, rice.

Method: Soften the onion 8 min, add the garlic and ginger 1 min, then the curry powder 1 min. Add the tomatoes, chicken and water, simmer 20 min until cooked through (75°C). Spoon over fluffy white rice.

Steps 1-3 in the video are AI images; step 4 is a real photo of the dish that inspired this home version.

title: Chicken with Yellow Rice & Peas: Easy Dinner in 4 Steps
caption:
Chicken with Yellow Rice & Peas: Easy Dinner in 4 Steps

Roast chicken with turmeric rice, peas and peppers. Serves 2.

You need: 4 chicken thighs, 1 tsp paprika, 2 peppers, 150 g cherry tomatoes, oil, 150 g rice, ½ tsp turmeric, 1 small carrot, 80 g peas, Greek yogurt, salt.

Method: Roast the chicken, peppers and tomatoes at 200°C (fan 180) 35-40 min until cooked through (75°C). Cook the rice with the turmeric and diced carrot; peas for the last 3 min. Serve with the peppers and a spoon of yogurt.

title: Waffles with Bacon, Cinnamon Apples & Walnuts in 4 Steps
caption:
Waffles with Bacon, Cinnamon Apples & Walnuts in 4 Steps

Sweet and salty waffles with bacon, cinnamon apples and walnuts. Serves 2.

You need: 4 Belgian (Liège) waffles, 6 rashers of streaky bacon, 2 apples, 20 g butter, 1 tbsp brown sugar, ½ tsp cinnamon, a handful of walnuts, maple syrup, icing sugar.

Method: Cook the apple wedges in the butter, sugar and cinnamon 5-6 min. Fry the bacon until crisp. Warm the waffles at 180°C for 5 min. Pile on bacon, apples, walnuts and syrup.

title: Roast Duck Rice Bowl with Bok Choy & Soy Egg in 4 Steps
caption:
Roast Duck Rice Bowl with Bok Choy & Soy Egg in 4 Steps

Roast duck over rice with bok choy and a soy egg. Serves 2.

You need: 2 duck legs, 2 tbsp honey, 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 eggs, 2 bok choy, 1 courgette, rice.

Method: Boil the eggs 6½ min, cool, peel and soak in the soy sauce with 4 tbsp water for 2+ hours. Roast the duck at 180°C (fan 160) about 1½ hours, brushing with honey and soy for the last 15 min. Blanch the bok choy 1 min. Slice the duck over rice with greens and egg.

title: Pancakes with Yogurt, Nuts, Raisins & Honey in 4 Steps
caption:
Pancakes with Yogurt, Nuts, Raisins & Honey in 4 Steps

Pancakes with thick yogurt, toasted nuts, raisins and honey. Serves 2.

You need: 200 g self-raising flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs, 200 ml milk, butter, a handful each of almonds, walnuts and raisins, 150 g Greek yogurt, honey.

Method: Toast the nuts in a dry pan 3-4 min, shaking. Cook ladlefuls of batter until bubbles show, flip for 1 min. Layer with the yogurt and top. Top with nuts, raisins and honey.

title: Chinese-Style Spicy Crayfish at Home in 4 Steps
caption:
Chinese-Style Spicy Crayfish at Home in 4 Steps

Spicy Chinese-style crayfish. Serves 2.

You need: 1 kg frozen cooked whole crayfish, 6 garlic cloves, a thumb of ginger, 10 dried chillies, 1 tsp Sichuan peppercorns, 2 tbsp doubanjiang (chilli bean paste), 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 200 ml water, sesame seeds, coriander.

Method: Thaw and rinse. Fry the aromatics 1-2 min, add the crayfish, soy, sugar and water, simmer 5-8 min until piping hot. Finish with sesame and lots of coriander.

title: Crab Noodles with Ginger & Black Vinegar in 4 Steps
caption:
Crab Noodles with Ginger & Black Vinegar in 4 Steps

Crab noodles with ginger and black vinegar. Serves 2.

You need: 200 g white and brown crab meat, 30 g butter or lard, a thumb of ginger, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 1 tsp soy sauce, 200 g thin wheat noodles, 2 bok choy, chives, Chinkiang black vinegar.

Method: Fry half the ginger, finely chopped, in the fat 1 min, add the crab and wine, warm 3-4 min. Boil the noodles and toss with the soy. Crab over the noodles; vinegar on the side.
